stem: A is a point on a line L. A circle with radius ${=r}$ cm is drawn through A. What is the greatest possible distance, in cm, between A and another point on this circle?
solution: The circle passes through A, so A is on the circle and its center M is ${=r}$ cm from A.
The farthest point from A on the circle is the end of the diameter through A.
notes: Standard: uses center M at distance r from A; answer is the diameter. PIPELINE NORMALISATION (not an author edit): the parent expl:pp3u9-3-1:bk-drill-1 became the book question q:pp3u9-3-1:bk-drill-1 when compile learned to mark its answer; re-pointed.
